snippet.title: 키퍼에 막힌 음바페의 대처
snippet.description:
피치 위 박스 안에서 환상적인 헛다리 스텝오버 페이크로 수비 타이밍을 완전히 뺏은 킬리안 음바페가 니어포스트를 겨냥해 회심의 오른발 슈팅을 날렸으나 골키퍼의 동물적인 선방에 막혀 튕겨 나오자, 뒤따라 쇄도하는 상대 수비수를 등지고 공을 완벽하게 소유한 뒤 이미 골문을 비우고 튀어나온 골키퍼의 빈틈을 노려 침투하던 주드 벨링엄에게 자로 잰 듯한 전광석화 컷백 킬패스를 찔러 넣어 완벽한 골 찬스를 만들어주었음에도 벨링엄의 슈팅이 허무하게 빗나가며 머리를 감싸 쥘 수밖에 없었던 전율의 찬스 메이킹 명장면이 포착되었습니다.

도대체 음바페는 자신의 결정적인 슈팅이 막혀 템포가 죽어버린 절체절명의 혼전 상황 속에서도 어떻게 수비수의 압박을 등지고 단 0.1초 만에 침투하는 동료의 동선을 읽어내며 골키퍼와 수비벽 사이의 유일한 패스 길을 꿰뚫어 볼 수 있었던 것일까요?

사건은 음바페가 특유의 폭발적인 스피드와 현란한 헛다리 드리블로 상대 측면을 허물고 각도를 좁혀 들어간 뒤 골문 구석으로 때려 넣은 슈팅을 골키퍼가 필사적으로 쳐내면서 시작되었습니다!

snippet.title: Windows Search Getting More Copilot
snippet.description:
Writer: Brett Stelmaszek
Editor: Jayson van Kerckhoven
Music by: @UFD-Music

Microslop doing this to Windows has me irrationally perturbed.
They’ve been working hard to slim down, speed up, and de-slop so much of the operating system over the last few months. They promised less copilot, made the OS consume less RAM, and even fixed search by letting you turn off internet so it’s all local.
And then they completely undermine that with one presentation.
They’ve now announced they’ll be revamping Windows Search to be more “agentic” so that you can just talk to it instead of normally searching for things. They say it should be fast, but we’ve heard this before.
Honestly, it feels like they have an AI team that’s forcing this out, while the team who actually cares about Windows  is bound and gagged in the back room.
And the reason they’re doing it is so absurd. They said quote “To make AI a part of everyday life, we need to bring it to places people use the most — into the flow of human ambition. We're moving into a future where everyone can simply express what they want, and their Windows PC, with their permission, can take action on their behalf."

They’ve been working hard to slim down, speed up, and de-slop so much of the operating system over the last few months. They promised less copilot, made the OS consume less RAM, and even fixed search by letting you turn off internet so it’s all local.
And then they completely undermine that with one presentation.
They’ve now announced they’ll be revamping Windows Search to be more “agentic” so that you can just talk to it instead of normally searching for things. They say it should be fast, but we’ve heard this before.
Honestly, it feels like they have an AI team that’s forcing this out, while the team who actually cares about Windows  is bound and gagged in the back room.
And the reason they’re doing it is so absurd. They said quote “To make AI a part of everyday life, we need to bring it to places people use the most — into the flow of human ambition. We're moving into a future where everyone can simply express what they want, and their Windows PC, with their permission, can take action on their behalf."

snippet.title: Spektakulärer Einbau am Nord-Ostsee-Kanal: Europas Wasserbauprojekt erreicht Meilenstein | NDR Info
snippet.description:
Schleuse Brunsbüttel: Neues Schleusentor bringt Ausbau des Nord-Ostsee-Kanals voran

Am Nord-Ostsee-Kanal ist ein wichtiger Bauabschnitt abgeschlossen worden: In Brunsbüttel wurde das elbseitige Schiebetor der neuen fünften Schleusenkammer eingebaut. Mit dem Einsetzen der 2.300 Tonnen schweren Stahlkonstruktion ist die Schleuse nach rund zwölf Jahren Bauzeit baulich weitgehend fertiggestellt. Das Großprojekt gilt als zentraler Baustein für die Modernisierung einer der wichtigsten Wasserstraßen Europas.

Präzisionsarbeit bei Europas großem Wasserbauprojekt

Der Einbau des 47 Meter langen Schleusentors erforderte millimetergenaue Arbeit. Mehrere Schlepper manövrierten die Konstruktion in die vorgesehene Torkammer. Das Tor bewegt sich später auf Führungsschienen und muss die Schleusenkammer zuverlässig gegen die Elbe abdichten. Die fünfte Schleusenkammer soll die Kapazitäten in Brunsbüttel erweitern und die Anfälligkeit des Kanals für Betriebsstörungen verringern. Der Nord-Ostsee-Kanal zählt zu den wichtigsten Verbindungen für die internationale Schifffahrt zwischen Nord- und Ostsee.

Kostensteigerungen und nächste Schritte

Während der Bauarbeiten kam es unter anderem durch schwierige Gründungsarbeiten und die Beseitigung von Altlasten zu Verzögerungen. Dadurch stiegen die Projektkosten deutlich gegenüber den ursprünglichen Planungen. Vor der Inbetriebnahme stehen nun umfangreiche Funktions- und Sicherheitstests an. Erst nach deren Abschluss kann die neue Schleusenkammer schrittweise in den regulären Betrieb übergehen und die bestehenden Anlagen entlasten.

Weniger Wartezeiten für die Schifffahrt

Mit der neuen Schleusenkammer soll die Zuverlässigkeit des Nord-Ostsee-Kanals langfristig verbessert werden. Ziel ist es, Wartezeiten für Schiffe zu reduzieren und notwendige Instandhaltungsarbeiten flexibler durchführen zu können. Ergänzend entsteht in Brunsbüttel zusätzliche Infrastruktur für Wartung und Reparaturen der Schleusentore. Dadurch sollen Ausfälle künftig schneller behoben werden können.

Es ist ein wichtiger Schritt für die Zukunft des Nord-Ostsee-Kanals. Mit dem Einbau des elbseitigen Riesen-Tores ist die neue fünfte Kammer in Brunsbüttel komplett. Abgeschlossen ist das Projekt aber noch nicht. Mehr dazu: https://www.ndr.de/nachrichten/schleswig-holstein/nordostseekanal-102.html

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.title: MANIFESTANTES FAZEM NOVO ATO EM APOIO A LULA NO LARGO DA BATATA, EM SP
snippet.description:
Apoiadores do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) se reúnem nesta terça-feira (13), no Largo da Batata, na Zona Oeste de São Paulo, para uma manifestação em apoio à reeleição do petista. Lula disputará o segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

A mobilização foi convocada por aliados do presidente e deve reunir nomes como os ex-ministros Fernando Haddad, Simone Tebet e Marina Silva, que foram derrotados nas eleições deste ano. Também são esperados deputados federais e estaduais eleitos pela coligação, entre eles Luna Zarattini (PT), Eduardo Suplicy (PT), Erika Hilton (Psol), Sâmia Bomfim (Psol) e Guilherme Cortez (Psol).

snippet.title: Llevé a mi nuera al campo a buscar las flores que comía desde niña
snippet.description:
🌺🌿 ¡Hola, mi hermosa familia! Hoy quiero compartirles un día muy bonito que pasé junto a mi nuera Mony. Nos fuimos al campo a buscar unas hermosas flores de ayocote, que en esta temporada se dan solitas entre la vegetación y que aquí en nuestro pueblo de Oaxaca nos encanta aprovechar para preparar nuestros alimentos. ❤️

Durante nuestro recorrido nos llevamos una que otra sorpresa 😅, disfrutamos de la naturaleza y recordamos cómo desde pequeñas aprendimos a conocer y aprovechar estas florecitas.

Después de tanto caminar, regresamos a casa con nuestras cubetas llenas y preparamos tres comidas diferentes:

🌺 Flor de ayocote con chorizo.

🍳 Tortitas de flor de ayocote con huevo.

🧀 Flor de ayocote frita con chile y quesillo.

Cada preparación tiene su sabor especial y al final les compartimos cuál fue nuestra favorita. 😋

Me da mucho gusto poder compartirles estas comidas sencillas que forman parte de nuestras costumbres y que nos recuerdan lo bonito que es aprovechar lo que nos regala el campo.

💬 Cuéntenme en los comentarios: ¿en sus pueblos también se da esta flor? ¿La conocen con otro nombre? ¿De qué manera acostumbran prepararla?

Muchas gracias por acompañarnos en una aventura más. Les mando un fuerte abrazo y que Dios los bendiga. ❤️🌿

snippet.title: 내년 참전유공자 수당 10만원 인상되는 지자체 어디?
snippet.description:
지금 우리가 누리고 있는 안전과 자유는
보이지 않는 곳에서 나라를 위해 몸과 마음을 바치신 국가유공자분들의 헌신 덕분입니다.
그 숭고한 희생과 공로에 깊이 머리 숙여 감사드립니다.

그리고 안내 말씀 한 가지 드립니다.
국가유공자 라디오에서 전달드리는 정보는 촬영 및 편집 시점의 기준이며,
제도 개정이나 행정 지침에 따라 내용이 일부 변경될 수 있습니다.
정확한 최신 정보 확인을 위해서는
📌 국가보훈부 공식 홈페이지
📌 정부24 등의 공식 서비스를 꼭 함께 확인하시기 바랍니다.

이번 영상에서는 나라에서 수당을 지급했음에도 불구하고, 실제로는 복지 사각지대에 놓여 어려움을 겪는 복지 역전 현상의 실태를 분석합니다. 삼척시 복지정책과가 추진하는 정책의 방향성과 조례 개정이 현장에 어떤 영향을 미치고 있는지 상세히 확인해 볼 수 있습니다.

또한 보훈 대상자 자격 유지와 급여 관리 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 행정적 문제들을 다룹니다. 자격을 잃거나 급여에 차질이 생기는 상황을 방지하고, 어르신들이 건강한 삶을 유지하기 위해 반드시 알아야 할 기초생활보장 정보와 보훈 제도 관리 방법을 정리했습니다.

snippet.title: Kushmanda Stuti 2026 | Powerful Navratri Bhajan for Peace & Divine Blessings | Anant Bhajan
snippet.description:
Kushmanda Stuti 2026 | Powerful Navratri Bhajan for Peace & Divine Blessings | Anant Bhajan

Experience the divine grace of Kushmanda Stuti 2026, a beautiful Navratri Bhajan dedicated to Maa Kushmanda, the fourth divine form of Goddess Durga. This powerful Maa Kushmanda Stuti celebrates the radiant energy of the Divine Mother and inspires devotion, inner peace, spiritual strength, positive energy and divine blessings.

Listen to this soulful Kushmanda Mata Bhajan during Navratri Day 4, morning prayers, daily Devi Puja or meditation. This sacred Kushmanda Devi Stuti honors Maa Kushmanda, who is traditionally worshipped as the divine source of cosmic energy, light and creation.

Celebrate Navratri 2026 with this peaceful Kushmanda Stuti for Peace & Divine Blessings and deepen your connection with Maa Durga.

🌺 Jai Maa Kushmanda • Jai Mata Di 🙏
— Anant Bhajan

Lyrics:

नमस्ते कूष्माण्डे देवि जगन्मातर्नमोऽस्तु ते।
सृष्टिशक्तिस्वरूपे त्वं प्रसीद परमेश्वरि॥

मन्दस्मितमुखाम्भोजे दिव्यतेजोविराजिते।
सिंहवाहनसंयुक्ते कूष्माण्डे ते नमो नमः॥

अष्टभुजे महादेवि दिव्यायुधविभूषिते।
कमण्डलुधरे मातः रक्ष मां परमेश्वरि॥

नवरात्रिचतुर्थेऽह्नि भक्त्या त्वां पूजयाम्यहम्।
पुष्पधूपप्रदीपैश्च गृहाणार्चां जगदम्बिके॥

ब्रह्माण्डजननि देवि सूर्यमण्डलवासिनि।
अनन्ततेजसा युक्ते प्रसीद जगदीश्वरि॥

सूर्यकोटिसमप्रख्ये सर्वलोकप्रकाशिनि।
अज्ञानतिमिरं हृत्वा ज्ञानज्योतिं प्रकाशय॥

आदिशक्ते महादेवि सृष्टिस्थितिविधायिनि।
विश्वस्य जननि मातः कूष्माण्डे ते नमोऽस्तु ते॥

अमृतपूर्णकलशे जपमालाविभूषिते।
चक्रगदाधरे देवि पाहि मां करुणामयि॥

रोगशोकविनाशिनि भयक्लेशप्रणाशिनि।
आयुरारोग्यदायिनि प्रसीद परमेश्वरि॥

मनःशान्तिं च मे देहि धैर्यं शक्तिं प्रयच्छ मे।
सद्बुद्धिं निर्मलां भक्तिं देहि कूष्माण्डरूपिणि॥

सर्वमङ्गलदां देवीं सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनीम्।
सर्वसङ्कटहन्त्रीं च वन्दे कूष्माण्डरूपिणीम्॥

सिंहवाहिनि कल्याणि महाशक्तिस्वरूपिणि।
भक्तानां रक्षणार्थाय प्रसीद जगदम्बिके॥

आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं सुखसम्पत्समन्वितम्।
धर्मभक्तिं च मे देहि कूष्माण्डे परमेश्वरि॥

तव पादाम्बुजे नित्यं भक्तिर्मे निश्चला भवेत्।
तव कृपाप्रसादेन जीवनं मङ्गलं भवेत्॥

ये स्मरन्ति महादेवीं कूष्माण्डां भक्तिसंयुताः।
तेषां चित्तेषु नित्यं हि शान्तिर्भक्तिश्च वर्धताम्॥

जय जय कूष्माण्डे मातः जय दुर्गे महेश्वरि।
जय विश्वप्रसूते देवि रक्ष मां करुणामयि॥
